data.title: Address Residences
data.about:
The Address Residences Dubai Creek Harbour apartments offer a unique blend of luxury and serenity, set against the backdrop of Dubai's iconic waterfront. The exclusive residence by Emaar Properties provides an unparalleled living experience with its meticulously designed 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom townhouses. Live in modern branded homes surrounded by lush greenery and pristine beaches.The townhouses enhance the appeal with rooftop terraces that provide panoramic views of the canal.

Beyond its stunning aesthetics, Address Residences at Dubai Creek Harbour boasts world-class amenities that cater to every need. From tranquil swimming pools and a state-of-the-art gym to beautifully landscaped podium decks and dedicated children's play areas, the community offers a perfect balance of relaxation and activity. Its prime location ensures seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major road networks, metro stations, and also a water taxi.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Residences Combining Modern Sophistication with Timeless Design!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Bask in stunning beach views along Dubai Creek and a luxurious waterfront living experience.
  • Choose from luxurious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments or spacious 3-bedroom townhouses, each thoughtfully designed for comfort and style.
  • Designed with sustainability at its core, the development includes advanced lighting controls, energy-efficient systems, and smart waste management.
  • Benefit from exceptional connectivity with easy access to major road networks, four metro stations, and a water taxi to Downtown Dubai.
  • Developed by Emaar, a trusted name with a proven track record of delivering iconic projects like Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall.
  • Flexible payment plan with 80% during construction and 20% on completion, making luxury living more accessible.

location_tile.title: The Masterfully Planned Community Offers a Mix of Residential and Recreational Spaces
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Address Residences Dubai Creek Harbour location in a prime district near Creek Island makes it an excellent choice for those who embrace an active lifestyle. Residents can stroll along the picturesque waterfront promenade, enjoy the well-designed play areas, and embark on exciting adventures at the nearby cycling track and skate park. 
The community also offers a variety of sports courts, catering to those with a competitive edge, while the convenient connections to the RTA ferry terminal and metro station ensure smooth and effortless travel across Dubai.

Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary - 5 minutes
Burj Khalifa - 10 minutes
Dubai International Airport - 15 minutes
Downtown Dubai - 15 minutes
